title: Letors1s's Enchantments
description: Adds new enchantments for tools, weapons and armor.
body:
## About
>   **"Letors1s's Enchantments"** - adds some new enchantments for vanilla Minecraft.
  
## Enchantments list:
  > **Lava Walker** - While you walking on a lava, makes obsidian beneath your feet.
> 
  > **God Touch** - Allows mining spawners.
> 
  > **Miner** - breaks nearest ores.
> 
  > **And other...**

more to come...

## Translations:
  > **rus** (Русский)
>
  > **eng** (English)

## Requirements:
> **Mod Loader**: Neoforge

No additional dependencies or configuration required. Just install and play.
  :)
